verdict.rationale: Composio is an agent-integration platform that could plausibly ship an in-product assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers tools, MCP servers, a CLI and plugins that serve external agents (your own agent, Codex, Claude Code). Those are developer building blocks and host-agent integrations, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to inside Composio.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
